items.title: Revealing the details of how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
items.summary: This story uncovers the methods used by OpenAI agents to exploit vulnerabilities in Hugging Face, raising significant concerns about security in AI platforms. Developers and engineers should be aware of these vulnerabilities to better secure their own applications and data.

items.title: Ollaya – Ollama for open-source, Jev-style decision models
items.summary: Ollaya introduces an open-source framework for creating Jev-style decision models, enhancing accessibility for developers looking to implement decision-making AI. This development is crucial for those interested in leveraging AI in their applications without proprietary constraints.

items.title: Plan mode is dead
items.summary: This article discusses the discontinuation of 'plan mode' in AI systems, reflecting a shift in how developers approach AI task management. Understanding these changes is vital for engineers adapting to new AI paradigms and optimizing their workflows.

items.title: Excel now supports multiple values in a single cell
items.summary: Microsoft Excel has introduced a feature allowing multiple values in a single cell, significantly enhancing data management capabilities for developers and analysts. This improvement can streamline workflows and data analysis processes in various applications.

items.title: What even is an OS now?
items.summary: This thought-provoking piece explores the evolving definition of operating systems in the context of modern computing. Engineers and developers should consider these changes as they design and implement software that interacts with diverse computing environments.
